coverage: All twelve available scenes in both English editions, including the surviving Sly-frame interruption, named household servants and references. The source editions omit the opening Induction; its absent cast is not claimed as covered. Disguises and marriage changes are source-gated.

entities.name: Katherina Minola
entities.body: Baptista’s elder daughter and Bianca’s sister; one of the play’s two central characters.

snapshots.body: Baptista’s elder daughter and Bianca’s sister.
Petruchio’s wife, Baptista’s elder daughter and Bianca’s sister.

entities.name: Petruchio
entities.body: A gentleman from Verona seeking a wealthy wife; one of the play’s two central characters.

snapshots.body: Katherina’s husband, a gentleman from Verona.

entities.name: Bianca Minola
entities.body: Baptista’s younger daughter and Katherina’s sister, courted by several men.

snapshots.body: Lucentio’s wife, Baptista’s younger daughter and Katherina’s sister.

entities.name: Lucentio
entities.body: Vincentio’s son, a young gentleman who comes to Padua to study.

snapshots.body: Vincentio’s son, courting Bianca while disguised as the tutor Cambio.
Bianca’s husband and Vincentio’s son; formerly disguised as Cambio.

entities.name: Tranio
entities.body: Lucentio’s resourceful servant and companion.

snapshots.body: Lucentio’s servant, posing as his master.
Lucentio’s servant, who impersonated him during the courtship.

entities.name: Baptista Minola
entities.body: The wealthy Paduan father of Katherina and Bianca.

entities.name: Gremio
entities.body: An elderly, wealthy suitor of Bianca.

entities.name: Hortensio
entities.body: A suitor of Bianca and a friend of Petruchio.

snapshots.body: Bianca’s suitor, disguised as the music teacher Licio.
Petruchio’s friend, formerly Bianca’s suitor and the disguised tutor Licio.
The widow’s husband and Petruchio’s friend; formerly disguised as Licio.

entities.name: Grumio
entities.body: Petruchio’s servant, who accompanies him from Verona.

entities.name: Biondello
entities.body: One of Lucentio’s servants.

entities.name: Vincentio
entities.body: Lucentio’s father, a wealthy merchant from Pisa.

entities.name: Antonio
entities.body: Petruchio’s late father.

entities.name: Curtis
entities.body: A servant at Petruchio’s country house.

entities.name: The Pedant
entities.body: The elderly traveler from Mantua whom Biondello spots; called the Pedant.

snapshots.body: The traveler from Mantua whom Tranio recruits to impersonate Vincentio.

entities.name: The widow
entities.body: The wealthy widow who is fond of Hortensio.

entities.name: Christopher Sly
entities.body: The tinker watching the play in its framing scene.

entities.name: Bartholomew, the page
entities.body: The page playing Sly’s wife in the framing scene.

entities.name: Ferdinand
entities.body: Petruchio’s cousin, whom he summons at his country house.

entities.name: Nathaniel
entities.body: One of the servants in Petruchio’s household.

entities.name: Joseph
entities.body: One of the servants in Petruchio’s household.

entities.name: Nicholas
entities.body: One of the servants in Petruchio’s household.

entities.name: Philip
entities.body: One of the servants in Petruchio’s household.

entities.name: Walter
entities.body: One of the servants in Petruchio’s household.

entities.name: Sugarsop
entities.body: One of the servants in Petruchio’s household.

entities.name: Gregory
entities.body: One of the servants in Petruchio’s household.

entities.name: Gabriel
entities.body: One of the servants in Petruchio’s household.

entities.name: Peter
entities.body: One of the servants in Petruchio’s household.

entities.name: Adam
entities.body: One of the servants in Petruchio’s household.

entities.name: Ralph
entities.body: One of the servants in Petruchio’s household.

entities.name: The servant attending Sly
entities.body: The servant who reminds Sly to watch the play.

entities.name: Baptista’s servant
entities.body: A servant in Baptista’s household.

entities.name: Petruchio’s unnamed servant
entities.body: One of Petruchio’s household servants.

entities.name: The tailor
entities.body: The craftsman hired to make Katherina’s gown.

entities.name: The haberdasher
entities.body: The craftsman who brings a cap for Katherina.

entities.name: The wedding priest
entities.body: The priest who conducts Katherina and Petruchio’s wedding.

entities.name: The sexton
entities.body: The church attendant at Katherina and Petruchio’s wedding.

entities.name: The priest at Saint Luke’s
entities.body: The priest whom Biondello arranges to be ready for Lucentio and Bianca.

entities.name: The officer
entities.body: The officer brought into the dispute outside Lucentio’s house.

entities.name: Troilus
entities.body: Petruchio’s spaniel.

entities.name: Petruchio’s servants
entities.body: The household servants at Petruchio’s country house.

entities.name: Aristotle
entities.body: The Greek philosopher whom Tranio mentions when discussing Lucentio’s studies.

entities.name: Ovid
entities.body: The Roman poet of love and mythology, contrasted with Aristotle in Tranio’s advice.

entities.name: Socrates
entities.body: The Greek philosopher mentioned through his marriage to Xanthippe.

entities.name: Xanthippe
entities.body: Socrates’s wife, traditionally portrayed as sharp-tempered.

entities.name: Lucretia
entities.body: The Roman woman traditionally celebrated for chastity, invoked in Petruchio’s comparison.

entities.name: Minerva
entities.body: The Roman goddess of wisdom and the arts, invoked in praise of Bianca.

entities.name: Anna
entities.body: Dido’s sister and confidante in Virgil’s Aeneid.

entities.name: Dido
entities.body: The queen of Carthage in Virgil’s Aeneid; Anna’s sister.

entities.name: Agenor
entities.body: The mythological king who is Europa’s father.

entities.name: Europa
entities.body: Agenor’s daughter, whom Jupiter carries to Crete in Greek myth.

entities.name: Jupiter
entities.body: The Roman king of the gods, called Jove.

entities.name: Florentius
entities.body: The knight in the medieval tale who promises to marry an apparently ugly old woman.

entities.name: Florentius’s bride
entities.body: The apparently ugly woman whom Florentius agrees to marry in the medieval tale.

entities.name: The Sibyl
entities.body: The ancient prophetess invoked as an example of extreme age.

entities.name: Leda
entities.body: The mythological mother of Helen of Troy.

entities.name: Helen of Troy
entities.body: Leda’s daughter, famed for her beauty and many suitors.

entities.name: Paris
entities.body: The Trojan prince associated with Helen of Troy.

entities.name: Hercules
entities.body: The mythological hero famed for his twelve labors; also called Alcides.

entities.name: Diana
entities.body: The Roman goddess of the hunt and chastity, called Dian in the original edition.

entities.name: Griselda
entities.body: The patient wife of medieval storytelling, called Grissel in Petruchio’s comparison.

entities.name: Priam
entities.body: The king of Troy named in the Latin lesson.

entities.name: Ajax
entities.body: The Greek warrior at Troy whom Lucentio identifies by the epithet Æacides.

entities.name: Aeacus
entities.body: Ajax’s grandfather in Greek myth, the ancestor referred to in the Latin lesson.

entities.name: Jack in the song
entities.body: The boy addressed in the song fragment quoted by Grumio.

entities.name: God
entities.body: The Christian deity invoked in the characters’ prayers and oaths.

entities.name: Saint Anne
entities.body: The saint traditionally identified as the Virgin Mary’s mother, invoked by Sly.

entities.name: Saint George
entities.body: The saint invoked in Petruchio’s oath.

entities.name: Saint James
entities.body: The saint invoked as Saint Jamy in Biondello’s oath.

entities.name: The Bentivoglio family
entities.body: The family from which Lucentio says his father Vincentio descends.

entities.name: The Duke of Venice
entities.body: The Venetian ruler named in Tranio’s invented story about a quarrel with Mantua.

entities.name: The Duke of Mantua
entities.body: The Mantuan ruler named in Tranio’s invented story about a quarrel with Venice.

entities.name: The Duke of Padua
entities.body: The ruler in whose name Vincentio demands an arrest.
